task.name: Dependency License Policy Enforcement
task.description: Review direct production dependencies declared by supported manifests and lockfiles on the default branch and surface only dependencies whose detected SPDX license is disallowed or unclassified under repository policy without an existing approved exception.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering direct production dependencies that violate repository license policy while avoiding duplicate attention for already tracked or explicitly approved exceptions.
activationConditions: A supported dependency manifest or lockfile changes on the default branch of a repository covered by the workflow policy.
Authoritative dependency and license evidence identifies a direct production dependency whose SPDX license is disallowed or unclassified by the repository policy.
requiredEffects: Each novel finding identifies the dependency coordinate, detected license evidence, applicable policy rule, and affected manifest or lockfile.
Each surfaced finding has a repository-linked safe output through which maintainers can resolve, dismiss, or approve an exception.
noopConditions: Every detected direct production dependency has a license allowed by repository policy.
Every supported disallowed or unclassified license finding is already tracked or covered by an approved exception.
successConditions: Supported license-policy findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer-approved exception within 14 days of the workflow run.
Compliant dependencies and previously accepted exceptions create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: Dual-licensed packages may require policy-specific interpretation of SPDX expressions.
Package metadata may be incomplete or disagree with license files included in the resolved package artifact.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel dependency-license-policy findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly approved within 14 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported license-policy findings it assigns for direct production dependencies in changed supported manifests or lockfiles.
acceptedEvidence: A merged default-branch change that removes, replaces, or updates the identified dependency so its resolved license satisfies repository policy before the evidence cutoff.
A closed repository tracking issue or repository-owned exception record that explicitly approves, dismisses, or resolves the identified dependency and license finding by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-license-policy-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-approved supported findings / supported novel license-policy findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 14 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel license-policy finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution or approval evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set, repository dependency policy, manifest or lockfile evidence, or required license classification evidence cannot be read.
